item.text:
**Subject: Moving Day Update**

Hi [Friend’s Name],

Thanks again for offering to help me move—I really appreciate it! It turns out the move is going to be much smaller and easier than I originally expected. I’ve already packed most things, and there are only a few boxes and pieces of furniture left to load and unload.

I think I’ll only need about an hour of your help, rather than taking up a big part of your day. If you’re still available, could you come by around [time] on [day]? Of course, no worries if your plans have changed.

Your help will make everything go much faster. I’ll have coffee and snacks ready as a small thank-you!

See you soon,  
[Your Name]
